mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_cancellation_mail (reservation_id,recipient,station_name,start_time,end_time,previous_status) SELECT r.id,u.email,s.name,sl.start_time,sl.end_time,r.status FROM tb_reservation r JOIN tb_user u ON u.id=r.user_id JOIN tb_station_slot sl ON sl.id=r.slot_id JOIN tb_station s ON s.id=sl.station_id WHERE r.slot_id=#{slotId} AND r.status IN ('SUCCESS','PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id FROM tb_admin_cancellation_mail WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=NOW(3) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,reservation_id LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM tb_admin_cancellation_mail WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin_cancellation_mail SET status='SENT',attempts=attempts+1,sent_at=NOW(3),last_error=NULL WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE tb_admin_cancellation_mail SET attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},last_error=#{error} WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND status='PENDING'
